can-diag.description: CAN bus diagnostics via NDR — v3 with correct devctl codes (class=5, cmd=7/8 from NavigationNdrInfo disassembly). Probes devctl format, scans ~25 ECU module addresses, reads fault codes, module info, and live sensor data. READ-ONLY — no writes to vehicle systems.
can-diag.short_description: CAN bus diagnostics via NDR — read-only vehicle probing.
can-diag.detail: CAN bus diagnostics via NDR — read-only vehicle probing.

can-scanner.description: CAN bus / namespace address scanner - discovers what vehicle data is available via GEM key-value polling on your specific MMI3G system
can-scanner.short_description: CAN bus address scanner — discover RPM, boost, coolant, speed
can-scanner.detail: Live address scan via per3 namespace. Great for discovering custom data for gauges dashboard.

diag-tool.description: UDS diagnostic scanner for VAG modules — simulated transport + full UDS client (alpha). Live mode requires external VAG-COM interface (VCDS HEX, VNCI 6154a). Installed as a Java JAR artifact; no GEM screens.
diag-tool.short_description: UDS diagnostic scanner — needs VAG-COM cable
diag-tool.detail: Auto-scans modules, reads/clears DTCs. Alpha — requires external diagnostic hardware.

dns-refresh-probe.description: One-shot network diagnostic that snapshots route/DNS state, rewrites /etc/resolv.conf to a better DNS candidate, and reruns connectivity checks.
dns-refresh-probe.short_description: One-shot route/DNS diagnostic and temporary /etc/resolv.conf refresh
dns-refresh-probe.detail: Snapshots route and DNS state, backs up /etc/resolv.conf to SD, rewrites nameserver to /dns-refresh-target.txt override or the default gateway, then reruns connectivity checks.

dtc-checker.description: Onboard diagnostic trouble code reader for GEM using DSI namespace 2 IOC diagnostic data.
dtc-checker.short_description: Onboard diagnostic trouble code reader — view and clear DTCs from the GEM
dtc-checker.detail: 3 GEM screens: DTC overview (20 rows), single DTC detail with status flags, and DTC control (clear/test). Uses DSI namespace 2 via IOC. V850 IOC has TP2.0 diagnostic protocol support.

game-loader.description: Java game launcher for MMI3G — run games from SD card on the J9 JVM. Use SD slot 2 as your game library!
game-loader.short_description: Run Java games on the MMI's J9 JVM from SD card
game-loader.detail: Launcher module plus example games. Loads signed JARs via the built-in job framework.

gauges-dashboard.description: Live vehicle telemetry dashboard - battery voltage, GPS status, system info with data logging to SD card
gauges-dashboard.short_description: Live telemetry — voltage, GPS, system info, data logging
gauges-dashboard.detail: 3 GEM screens with 500ms battery polling, GPS satellite tracking, and one-tap data logging to SD card.

gem-activator.description: Enable/disable the Green Engineering Menu from SD card — creates /HBpersistence/DBGModeActive. No VCDS needed!
gem-activator.short_description: Enable the Green Engineering Menu from SD card — creates /HBpersistence/DBGModeActive.
gem-activator.detail: Creates the DBGModeActive file marker checked by the MMI firmware at boot. Reboot after running to activate GEM.

gemmi-dump.description: Extract GEMMI (Google Earth) binaries and config from HDD for offline analysis — needed for auth bypass patching
gemmi-dump.short_description: Extract Google Earth binaries from HDD for offline analysis and patching
gemmi-dump.detail: Copies gemmi_final, libembeddedearth.so, and all GEMMI config/scripts to SD card. Needed for offline Google Earth reverse engineering.

google-earth.description: Google Earth satellite imagery restoration — CONFIRMED WORKING. On-car proxy serves dbRoot + auth locally, forwards tiles to kh.google.com via plain HTTP. No PC required.
google-earth.short_description: Google Earth satellite imagery — live tiles from Google's servers
google-earth.detail: Restores Google Earth satellite imagery to MMI3G+ head units. Deploys an on-car proxy that serves map data directly from Google's tile servers. Requires working internet via LTE, Wi-Fi tethering, USB Ethernet, or equivalent.

google-earth-gemmi-wrappers.description: Install legacy /scripts/GEMMI control-script wrappers so the OEM GoogleEarth GEM screen can call the donor GEMMI runtime already deployed under /mnt/nav/gemmi/.
google-earth-gemmi-wrappers.short_description: Install legacy /scripts/GEMMI controls expected by the OEM Google Earth screen
google-earth-gemmi-wrappers.detail: Installs shell wrappers for activate/deactivate/start/stop/cache controls that forward to the deployed /mnt/nav/gemmi runtime.

google-earth-p0824-deploy.description: Deploy the bundled EU VW P0824 GEMMI donor payload to /mnt/nav/gemmi with on-car backup and minimal drivers.ini auth-bypass patching. SD-card only; does not modify lsd.jxe or firmware.
google-earth-p0824-deploy.short_description: Deploy bundled EU VW P0824 GEMMI donor payload to /mnt/nav/gemmi
google-earth-p0824-deploy.detail: Backs up the existing /mnt/nav/gemmi tree, copies the bundled EU VW P0824 GEMMI payload from SD card root /gemmi, and adds minimal drivers.ini auth-bypass settings. Does not patch lsd.jxe or firmware.

google-earth-p0824-restore.description: Restore /mnt/nav/gemmi to the pre-deploy state saved by google-earth-p0824-deploy. SD-card only; does not touch firmware.
google-earth-p0824-restore.short_description: Restore /mnt/nav/gemmi from the backup made by P0824 GEMMI Deploy
google-earth-p0824-restore.detail: Uses /mnt/nav/.mmi3g_toolkit/google-earth-p0824/active.env to restore the previous GEMMI tree or remove the donor tree if none existed before deploy.

jvm-extract.description: Extract J9 JVM runtime, UI framework JARs, and application config for offline reverse engineering — the first step toward custom MMI menu entries
jvm-extract.short_description: Extract J9 JVM and UI framework for reverse engineering
jvm-extract.detail: Copies J9 runtime and AppDevelopment.jar to SD for offline analysis.

long-coding.description: Display current long-coding / adaptation values for each configurable MMI feature. Read-only display module — for safe editing use VCDS or ODIS.
long-coding.short_description: Live display of adaptation values via GEM (read-only)
long-coding.detail: 3 GEM screens for car-device and CAN routing. Read-only — use VCDS/ODIS to change values.

lte-setup.description: Provision MMI3G+ for LTE mobile data via USB Ethernet adapter — replaces defunct internal 3G modem with external LTE router
lte-setup.short_description: USB Ethernet for LTE data + persistent root shell (port 23 + 2323)
lte-setup.detail: Creates DLinkReplacesPPP flag, enables DHCP on en5, installs dhcp-up for DNS. Adds persistent root shell on port 2323 (inetd.conf) and passwordless root login on port 23 (DrGER2 shadow method). Requires ASIX-based USB Ethernet adapter + LTE router. Restore script cleanly reverts everything.

map-parser.description: Extract and analyze navigation database config — reads nav DB version, map regions, configured paths, and FSC activation state. Read-only.
map-parser.short_description: Extract nav DB descriptor, FSC state, map metadata
map-parser.detail: Dumps acios_db.ini, FSC activation files, nav HDD inventory for offline analysis.

nav-unblocker.description: Bypass navigation database activation check - uses DrGER2's improved manage_cd.sh patch method (Keldo's discovery)
nav-unblocker.detail: Patches manage_cd.sh to terminate vdev-logvolmgr. Persistent, reversed by firmware reinstall.

password-finder.description: Dump stored Wi-Fi hotspot passwords, Audi Connect credentials, and other stored secrets from the MMI's persistence partitions. Read-only — changes nothing on the unit.
password-finder.short_description: Dump stored Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Audi Connect credentials
password-finder.detail: Read-only scan of /mnt/efs-persist and /mnt/persist. Inspired by jilleb/mib2-toolbox.

per3-reader.description: Read per3 / DSI persistence values from shell scripts. Ships an OSGi bundle that installs into the DSITracer.jar slot on /mnt/efs-system/lsd/ — on MMI boot, the bundle registers as a DSIPersistenceListener and serves synchronous reads through a file-based trigger mechanism. Answers the long-standing 'how do I read per3 addresses without writing a Java GEM screen' question.
per3-reader.short_description: Read DSI persistence values from shell scripts via Java OSGi bundle
per3-reader.detail: OSGi bundle installs into DSITracer.jar slot. After reboot, shell scripts can read DSI persistence values. Requires reboot after install.

per3-writer.description: Write DSI persistence values from shell scripts via OSGi bundle. Enables GEM activation, coding changes, and feature configuration entirely from SD card — no VCDS/ODIS needed.
per3-writer.short_description: Write DSI persistence values — planned DSI bridge for coding changes
per3-writer.detail: Design phase. Same OSGi pattern as per3-reader but calls DSIPersistence requestWriteInt. Needs per3-reader verification and live safety testing first.

persistence-dump.description: Dumps persistence state (HBpersistence, efs-persist, shmem, coding) to SD card for offline analysis — use before/after VCDS changes to find exact byte locations
persistence-dump.short_description: Dump persistence data and configuration to SD.
persistence-dump.detail: Dump persistence data and configuration to SD.

region-audit.description: Read-only region and VZE/TSR audit. Shows live region-related persistence values in GEM and writes a structured audit report to SD card.

splash-screen.description: Custom boot splash screen installer - upload any image, auto-formatted to 800x480 PNG via the desktop app
splash-screen.short_description: Custom boot logo — use the formatter tab to prepare your image
splash-screen.detail: Copies 800x480 PNG to /mnt/efs-system/etc/splashscreens/. Backs up factory screens automatically.

system-info.description: Comprehensive system diagnostic — gathers identity, activations, credentials, storage, network, persistence state, and backs up key files to SD card. Single pass, no flash writes.
system-info.short_description: Complete diagnostic — identity, activations, credentials, nav DB, persistence backup, bus topology. Single pass, no flash writes.
system-info.detail: 14-section report: system identity, GEM state, activation/FSC, credentials + sweep, storage, network, installed mods, HBpersistence backup, processes, syslog, nav DB/map/acios_db.ini, credential sweep, CVALUE/FSC file backup, QNX kernel + IPC/DSP/MOST/CAN bus topology. Consolidates system-info + password-finder + variant-dump + persistence-dump + map-parser.

variant-dump.description: MMI identification + configuration dumper — captures train name, MU software version, MU variant, HMI region, kernel info, HDD/partition layout, nav database state, FSC status, persistence file inventory, and LVM unblocker status. Mirrors DrGER2's mmi3ginfo3 approach. Read-only, writes a text report to SD card.
variant-dump.short_description: System ID dump — train, versions, FSC status, partitions, nav DB state
variant-dump.detail: Car-device list, CAN assignments, ID strings, live sensors. Uses filesystem-backed sources and logs to SD.

gemmi_assets.note: Downloaded from GitHub Release assets (not in git repo). Only fetched when google-earth module is selected.
